description: From the legendary show in 2009 when more than sixty musicians convened to play the music of J Dilla. Its the 2022 remix! Irish award winning MC teams up with Brazilian beat gurus to create a beautiful fitting tribute to the original idea, raise it up for Dilla, Ma Dukes and Miguel Atwood Ferguson.
credits:
Written by Denise Chaila
Produced by Deekapz
Recording Engineer - Ian Ring (Boku) and David Anthony Curley

Mixed by Simon Guzman
Mastered by Kelly Hibbert
